tools.name: lookupOrder
tools.description: Retrieves service order details from the database by order number

tools.name: routeByIntent
tools.description: Routes conversation flow to the appropriate handler node based on detected user intent, handling escalations and human takeovers

tools.name: routeAfterSupport
tools.description: Determines the next step after support node completes - routes to memory extraction on goodbye intent, otherwise to response

tools.name: buildGraph
tools.description: Constructs and compiles the LangGraph workflow graph that defines the WhatsApp agent conversation flow with all nodes and edges

tools.name: getCheckpointer
tools.description: Initializes or retrieves the conversation state checkpointer, using PostgreSQL/Supabase for production or in-memory for development

tools.name: getGraph
tools.description: Lazy-loads and returns the compiled WhatsApp agent conversation graph, creating it if not already cached

tools.name: planPricingResponse
tools.description: Determines the appropriate pricing response strategy based on service order state, including handling payment pending scenarios and warranty status

tools.name: getCustomerInfo
tools.description: Extracts customer information from the assembled conversation context

tools.name: getActiveOrders
tools.description: Retrieves and sorts active service orders from context in descending order by service order number (newest first) for consistent ordering across calls

tools.name: getSessionInfo
tools.description: Extracts session information from the assembled conversation context

tools.name: shouldEscalate
tools.description: Determines whether a conversation should be escalated to a human agent based on whether escalation attempts have exceeded a threshold

tools.name: formatConversationHistory
tools.description: Formats recent conversation messages into a human-readable string for LLM prompt injection, showing message roles and content

tools.name: createInitialState
tools.description: Initializes a new WhatsApp conversation state object with default values from assembled context and lane configuration

tools.name: makeSO
tools.description: Creates a service order object with default values for warranty type, status, and cost, allowing partial overrides

tools.name: stateWithOrders
tools.description: Creates a mock or test state object populated with active orders and session information

tools.name: contactInfoNode
tools.description: Retrieves and provides contact phone numbers (agent line for self-service order status, store line for human assistance) from configuration

tools.name: parseCorrections
tools.description: Extracts and validates [CORRECT:field:value:reason] markers from LLM responses to identify customer data corrections, returning validated corrections and cleaned text

tools.name: applyCorrections
tools.description: Persists validated customer data corrections to the database by updating customer_memory and logging to interaction_history with human_correction source for audit trail

tools.name: deliveryLogisticsDispatchNode
tools.description: Routes delivery logistics handling based on service type, dispatching carry-in orders differently from door-to-door orders

tools.name: isFirstOutbound
tools.description: Checks whether this is the first assistant response in the conversation by examining conversation history for any prior assistant messages

tools.name: styleCtx
tools.description: Creates a context object for styling/formatting WhatsApp messages in delivery logistics conversations, combining state information with metadata about the conversation flow

tools.name: logThought
tools.description: Logs internal agent reasoning/thoughts to Supabase database for debugging and monitoring purposes during the delivery logistics workflow

tools.name: eventDetectorNode
tools.description: Detects specific events or intents from incoming WhatsApp messages using keyword-based detection followed by AI verification to prevent false positives

tools.name: memoryExtractionNode
tools.description: Extracts and processes conversation memory from chat history, likely for context awareness and continuity across messages

tools.name: joinSpanish
tools.description: Formats an array of strings into a grammatically correct Spanish conjunction list (e.g., 'A, B y C')

tools.name: multiOrderDisambiguation
tools.description: Generates Spanish text asking customer to clarify which order they're asking about when multiple active orders exist

tools.name: intakeFeeCopy
tools.description: Generates Spanish customer-facing message explaining the intake fee (290 or 390 MXN) that covers diagnostic costs

tools.name: quotedCopy
tools.description: Generates Spanish customer-facing message displaying the repair quote amount in Mexican pesos, noting that intake fee is included

tools.name: pricingAnswerNode
tools.description: Handles customer inquiries about pricing by retrieving active orders and generating appropriate responses based on order status and pricing information

tools.name: runSideEffects
tools.description: Executes side effects like registering cost follow-ups in the database based on an array of effect specifications

tools.name: truncateResponse
tools.description: Truncates text to fit WhatsApp's character limit, attempting to break at sentence boundaries (period or newline) when possible to avoid cutting mid-sentence

tools.name: buildEscalationResponse
tools.description: Generates a customer-facing escalation message in Mexican Spanish (tuteo) that informs the customer their issue is being reviewed by the team, optionally including order number for context

tools.name: resolveTypedReason
tools.description: Determines the structured escalation reason by checking for an explicit override in state, or mapping the customer's intent to a predefined escalation reason category

tools.name: buildHandoffContext
tools.description: Extracts and structures context information from conversation state for human agent handoff, including customer first name, register/tone, active order number, and store line for direct contact

tools.name: buildWaitTimeNotice
tools.description: Generates a time-sensitive notice message when a WhatsApp session window is about to expire, warning users they need to send a new message to continue assistance

tools.name: responseNode
tools.description: Core routing node that checks if conversation should be escalated based on state and threshold configuration, and preserves pre-set handoff text from upstream nodes

tools.name: escalationNode
tools.description: Marks conversation as escalated to human agent, determines customer-facing message through resolution order (pre-set text > typed reason handoff > legacy generic bounce), and persists escalation reason for dashboard filtering

tools.name: humanTakenOverNode
tools.description: Marks that a human agent has assumed control of the conversation and sends confirmation message to customer in Spanish

tools.name: normalizeIntentForVersion
tools.description: Validates and transforms intent values to ensure compatibility with specified taxonomy version (v1 or v2), mapping legacy intents to their v2 equivalents or falling back to default values

tools.name: classifyByKeywords
tools.description: Performs fast keyword-based intent classification by matching predefined keywords in user text using regex word-boundary detection, supporting Spanish punctuation

tools.name: makeClassificationSchema
tools.description: Creates a Zod validation schema for intent classification with intent enum and confidence score, supporting versioned intent taxonomies

tools.name: classifyByLLM
tools.description: Classifies customer message intent using LLM with structured output, includes primary model with fallback model for reliability

tools.name: routerNode
tools.description: Routes incoming WhatsApp messages by classifying intent using fast keyword matching first, falling back to LLM classification if no match

tools.name: statusNode
tools.description: Handles order status inquiries by executing tools to fetch order data and formatting response using LLM with fallback

tools.name: supportNode
tools.description: Handles support-related intents including goodbye messages and routes customers to appropriate support channels

tools.name: warrantyAnswerNode
tools.description: Handles warranty-related inquiries by checking active orders and generating appropriate responses based on warranty status

tools.name: baseState
tools.description: Returns a default/mock state object for testing with sample session, customer, and conversation data

tools.name: so
tools.description: Returns a mock service order object for testing with customizable override values

tools.name: assertNoHedgeWords
tools.description: Test assertion that verifies text does not contain hedge words (uncertain language) to ensure confident responses

tools.name: escalateDetectedEvent
tools.description: Logs and creates escalation events when specific issues are detected, with deduplication to prevent duplicate escalations for the same conversation

tools.name: EventDetector
tools.description: Interface definition for event detection components that analyze user messages and return detected events based on specific patterns or conditions

tools.name: verifyDetectedEvents
tools.description: Uses an LLM (gpt-4o-mini) to verify and filter candidate detected events, confirming which events are legitimate and suppressing false positives

tools.name: address
tools.description: Detects when a user message contains address information or address change requests by matching against predefined regex patterns

tools.name: order_received
tools.description: Detects when a user message indicates they have received an order by matching positive confirmation patterns while filtering out negative patterns

tools.name: payment_receipt
tools.description: Detects when a user uploads a payment receipt document or image by analyzing media messages and validating receipt characteristics
